summary: Texas Forest Service lookout in Jasper County near the old Cairo Springs settlement; marked gone, and a 1990 TSHA mention does not say whether it stood.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three sources were read; the TSHA entry gives the place history and the 1990 remark, the Central US Lookouts page gives the agency and county, and the FFLA list gives the gone status. Two web searches and the cached pages gave no build date, staffing or fire record. The TSHA 1990 sentence could mean the lookout was still standing, or only that it marked the site on a map then; this is not resolved. Record coordinates match the FFLA list exactly.
